title: Watch an RNN's State Evolve
tagline: Step a scalar RNN by hand and watch a whole sequence fold into one running number
summary: A recurrent net is one tiny cell applied over and over. Set w_x, w_h and b, feed an input sequence, and press Step to advance t=1,2,3… — each press shows the exact arithmetic h_t = tanh(w_x·x_t + w_h·h_{t-1} + b) with the numbers substituted, then plots the new state on the trajectory. Turn w_h up and watch the state saturate under tanh or blow up in linear mode: the whole vanishing/exploding story in one knob.
highlights: Step the recurrence one timestep at a time and see h_t = tanh(w_x·x_t + w_h·h_{t-1} + b) computed with the actual substituted numbers.
Plot the hidden-state trajectory against t, with a faint preview of where the current weights are heading.
Feed impulse, step, alternating, spike, or ramp inputs — or type your own comma-separated sequence.
Crank the recurrent weight w_h past 1 and watch the state saturate under tanh or explode in linear mode.
See the point of it all: one shared cell folds an entire sequence into a single running summary.
